author: GitHub
description:
Join us for Open Source Friday with Madelyn Olson, Valkey co-creator, maintainer, and Technical Steering Committee member.

Valkey is an open source, high-performance key-value data store used for caching, real-time applications, and workloads that need fast access to data. We’ll explore what it does, the story behind the project, and how its community is shaping its future.

Learn more and contribute at https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey.
title: Meet Valkey | Open Source Friday

author: GitHub
description:
What if one local AI model could understand your screen, transcribe meetings, and answer questions about what you’ve seen? Join us for Open Source Friday with Ayush Shekhar, creator of ScreenMind—an open source project that brings vision, audio, and reasoning together using a single Gemma 4 model, running locally on a GPU with as little as 4GB of VRAM.

Explore ScreenMind and contribute on GitHub: https://github.com/ayushh0110/ScreenMind
title: ScreenMind: Vision, Audio & Chat with Local AI | Open Source Friday

author: GitHub
description:
Low-quality pull requests and automated spam, often referred to as AI slop, have become a major burden for open-source maintainers. In this video, discover how GitHub’s PR limits feature allows maintainers to cap open pull requests from external contributors. Learn how upcoming features like counting draft PRs and trusted user bypasses help keep repository queues clean.
